subject: Partner-request: SI-led pilot credits + escrow clearance
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@stratusedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratusedge.com
Date: 2028-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: partner credits for SI-led pilot (StratusEdge + Redwood)

Hi Karthik,

Following our call this morning — StratusEdge is lined up to run a 10-week integration pilot for a regulated finance client. The SI will manage deployment and test workloads; they asked whether Redwood can provide partner-sourced promotional credits routed through the CloudBazaar marketplace for initial testing.

Key asks from our side:
- 20k token-equivalent credits for 10 weeks (rough estimate; we can reconcile against usage)
- Escrow-based activation: credits should sit in a cofund escrow and only release to the SI upon milestone sign-off
- Monthly usage report visible to both Redwood and StratusEdge
- Option to extend by 2 weeks if the client requests more time

Attached: pilot_scope.md (outline) and a short usage proposal. Happy to share procurement contact if you need a formal PO.

Can we get confirmation of the approval path and whether any legal or marketplace escrow docs are required?

Thanks —
Liam
Director, Strategic Partnerships
StratusEdge
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: partner credits for SI-led pilot (StratusEdge + Redwood)

Team — forwarding StratusEdge request. Short checklist below; please flag blockers.

Ask summary:
- 20k token credits, escrowed and released on milestone
- Monthly shared usage report + visibility in Console
- 2-week extension option

Operational questions:
1) Can Marketplace/CloudBazaar hold escrow and route credits to a partner-managed project?
2) What minimal legal approval do we need to allow an SI to redeem credits under the marketplace T&Cs?
3) Billing & reconciliation: do we invoice StratusEdge or let SI consume and send us usage-backed invoice?

Soojin — can you confirm Marketplace ops and whether we've done escrow-cleared SI flows before? Ben — can you surface typical credit amounts we approve for SI pilots and any required finance approvals? Marissa — can you prepare a short step-by-step so we can get this to Liam within 24 business hours?

-Karthik
Partner Growth, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-19T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: partner credits for SI-led pilot (StratusEdge + Redwood)

Thanks Karthik — quick answers from Marketplace Ops POV:

- Marketplace escrow: CloudBazaar supports a voucher/escrow model. We can mint partner-specific vouchers that live in a marketplace escrow and only become redeemable after we trigger release. Works for SI flows we've done in APAC/EU; legal requires a short addendum.
- Redemption: vouchers can be scoped to a project (project ID) and to specific SKUs (text-generation tokens). That aligns with the milestone-release request.
- Visibility: we can provide a read-only Console view to StratusEdge and a monthly usage CSV export.

Blockers & asks:
- Legal: need a 1-page marketplace escrow addendum (see past example attached: escrow_agreement_v1.pdf).
- Finance: need signoff for the 20k token estimate. If we treat as marketing cofund vs partner credit will change GL code.

I'll draft the step-by-step. Marissa, can you draft the email to procurement + a one-page SOW for the redemption milestones?

-Soojin
Head of Marketplace Ops
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-20T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner credits: finance & billing model

Quick finance stance: we can approve up to 25k token-equivalent credits for SI pilots under partner cofund (marketing expense) with manager approval. Requirements:
- A short SOW with milestones mapped to release triggers
- Usage reconciliation each month (CloudBazaar CSV + Console snapshot)
- A signed escrow addendum (legal) — I can run this through finance once legal confirms no revenue recognition impacts

Proposed workflow:
1) Marissa publishes SOW + milestone table (attached as pilot_scope.md)
2) Legal signs the escrow addendum and we upload to the CloudBazaar vendor portal
3) Finance pre-allocates voucher batch (20k tokens) and sets it to escrow state
4) On milestone sign-off, ops flips release flag and voucher redeems to the SI project

If that works, I'll draft the finance signoff email. Note: if StratusEdge wants invoicing instead of voucher redemption we can do net-30 billing but that delays redemption until PO clears.

-Ben
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@stratusedge.com>, CloudBazaar Partner Ops <partner-ops@cloudbazaar.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner credits for SI-led pilot (StratusEdge + Redwood) — next steps

Hi Liam — thanks for the patience. Internal alignment complete; summary and next steps below.

Summary of what we can provide:
- Redwood will allocate 20,000 token-equivalent vouchers scoped to the StratusEdge pilot project. Vouchers will be held in CloudBazaar escrow and released per milestone.
- Monthly usage CSV + Console view will be shared with both parties.
- We can include a 2-week extension option; extension must be requested 5 business days before the pilot end date.

Action items:
- StratusEdge: sign the attached escrow addendum (we've sent the DocuSign link) and confirm milestone owners
- CloudBazaar Partner Ops: please prepare voucher batch and provide voucher IDs once minted
- Marissa: please coordinate SOW -> PO creation for procurement and attach the SOW to the DocuSign envelope

Attachments: escrow_agreement_v1.pdf, stratusedge_usage_proposal.xlsx, pilot_scope.md

We aim to have vouchers minted and in escrow by 2028-10-27 if signatures are returned this week. Liam — can procurement confirm timeline?

Best,
Karthik
Partner Growth, Redwood Inference
